🚀 Big Launches.summary: Nvidia is reportedly set to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 B, aiming to tightly integrate the open‑source model hub with its GPU hardware ecosystem.

🎯 Interview Edge.summary: Amazon is adding 2 million Nvidia GPUs to its data centers, reflecting exploding demand for generative‑AI workloads.

🎯 Interview Edge.summary: Anthropic signed a $45 B compute agreement with infrastructure provider Nscale to power its next‑generation LLM training.
